python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np, json, math, subprocess
subprocess.run(['python3', '/work/compute_poses.py'])
poses = json.load(open('/work/poses.json'))
pose = poses['49']
print('Pose 49:', pose)

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0049.png')
# Floor lamp base: dark disc around u=80..160, v=370..430
# Floor color is around [144, 160, 168], base is dark blue/gray [60..100, 60..100, 60..100]
base_mask = (img[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110) & (img[:, :, 0] > 40)
# isolate the base region
m = base_mask.copy()
m[:350, :] = False
m[:, :60] = False
m[:, 170:] = False

ys, xs = np.where(m)
print(f'Lamp base: u min={xs.min()}, max={xs.max()}, mean={xs.mean():.1f}')
print(f'Lamp base: v min={ys.min()}, max={ys.max()}')

u_c = xs.mean()
v_bot = ys.max()

z_cam = 256.0 * 1.55 / (v_bot - 255.5)
x_cam = (u_c - 255.5) / 256.0 * z_cam
h_rad = math.radians(pose['h'])
xw = pose['x'] + x_cam * math.cos(h_rad) + z_cam * math.sin(h_rad)
yw = pose['y'] - x_cam * math.sin(h_rad) + z_cam * math.cos(h_rad)
print(f'Floor lamp from obs_0049: xw={xw:.3f}, yw={yw:.3f}')
"
